taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-17, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 21.0 | 3.05 | 3.05
2 | 251.5 | 15.26 | 18.31
3 | 420.6 | 1.34 | 19.65
4 | 513.2 | 0.88 | 20.53
5 | 496.2 | 17.89 | 38.42
6 | 4573.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AAKH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-17, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

Station T-17 in survey area T consists of a 6-layer model. The resistivity values show a steady increase from 21.0 ohm-m in the first layer up to 513.2 ohm-m in the fourth layer. A slight decrease is observed in the fifth layer (496.2 ohm-m), followed by a substantial increase to 4573.6 ohm-m in the basal layer. This resistivity pattern corresponds to an AAKH curve type, which is consistent with the station's classification currently on file.

{"curve_type_stated": "AAKH", "label_issue_flagged": false}
